notes: v482 — Lessons and Training are now two buttons in the top bar, and neither asks for a code. The 49 lessons used to be reachable only by knowing a secret, which made one of the better reasons to own this app invisible to the people who own it. Press 🎓 Lessons to read them; press 🎓 Training to have every button, column and tile explain itself on hover, and press it again to stop. Ctrl+Alt+T still works. This is only safe because the previous release took the tuned numbers out of those explanations — they now teach what a signal means, not the figure that fires it. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
